mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) signals stronger economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1's quarterly growth is negative over the horizon, 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE crossing above 5.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting reduced labor market tightness.
failure_condition: If UNRATE crosses above 5.0% but 20d returns are not positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (industrial activity) signal robust demand growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and HOUST increase in the same month
failure_condition: If proxies move in opposite directions or show no correlation with returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle, a decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the monetary easing cycle, 20d returns are not positive despite FEDFUNDS falling below 1.5% (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO (supply index) signals robust production growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO's monthly growth is negative over the horizon, 5d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly GDPC1 crossing above 16,000 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, indicating stronger economic output.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 crosses above 16,000 but 20d returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in UNRATE (unemployment) and PAYEMS (employment) signal labor market expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both UNRATE and PAYEMS increase in the same month
failure_condition: If proxies move in opposite directions or show no correlation with returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a monthly UNRATE drop below 4.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting weakening labor market pressures.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 4.5% in late-cycle but 5d returns are not positive (p > 0.05).
